requirement: The system shall ingest CMS Transparency in Coverage PUF for plan years 2022 through 2026
acceptance_criteria: All five workbooks ingested; row counts reconcile to source in `outputs/reconciliation.csv`

requirement: The system shall harmonize three source schema generations into one canonical panel
acceptance_criteria: Every source column is either mapped or listed as unmapped in the reconciliation output; no column is silently dropped
test_evidence: 3 generations harmonized; 25 source columns explicitly listed as unmapped (disclosed, not dropped silently)

requirement: The system shall preserve CMS suppression markers as distinguishable states rather than coercing them to zero
acceptance_criteria: Each measure has a companion `_flag` column recording `not_available`, `suppressed_small_cell`, `not_required`, or `not_applicable`; suppressed values are NULL, never 0
test_evidence: 32 flag columns; 17,347 rows carry >=1 suppression marker; 0 coerced to zero

requirement: The system shall deduplicate issuer-level measures to issuer grain before aggregation
acceptance_criteria: Issuer totals computed at issuer grain; DQ log quantifies the overstatement a naive sum would produce
test_evidence: 1,043 issuer-years, 0 duplicates; naive plan-grain sum would overstate volume 84.1x

requirement: The system shall suppress computed rates below a minimum denominator
acceptance_criteria: Denial rates require ≥ 100 claims received; overturn rates require ≥ 10 appeals filed
test_evidence: denominator floors enforced on denial and overturn rates

requirement: The system shall reject rates exceeding 100%
acceptance_criteria: Any rate > 1.0 is set NULL and logged with severity High

requirement: The system shall produce a data quality log with severity, finding, treatment, and rows affected
acceptance_criteria: `outputs/dq_log.csv` exists with all four attributes populated for every finding

requirement: The system shall map each payer denial reason category to an RCM root cause
acceptance_criteria: All 10 source categories mapped; no category unmapped

requirement: The system shall assign each root cause to a named accountable owner
acceptance_criteria: Every root cause carries an owner from the agreed org list

requirement: The system shall record representative X12 CARC codes for each root cause
acceptance_criteria: CARC examples present for all categories except `Unclassified`

requirement: The system shall compute denial reason mix only from plan-years whose categories reconcile to reported total denials
acceptance_criteria: Reason mix excludes non-reconciling rows; reconciliation rate is reported
test_evidence: mix computed on 4,640 of 25,666 plan-years (18%); shares sum to 1.0

requirement: The system shall express preventability per root cause as an explicit, adjustable parameter
acceptance_criteria: Preventability declared per category in config and adjustable in the dashboard

requirement: The system shall express appeal effort per root cause as an explicit, adjustable parameter
acceptance_criteria: Effort hours declared per category and flow into appeal cost

requirement: The system shall derive average allowed amount per claim from published payment data rather than assert it
acceptance_criteria: Derivation reads CMS DY2024 inpatient, outpatient, and physician files; every step is logged to `outputs/claim_value_derivation.csv`
test_evidence: $1,336.32/claim from 1,506,136 distinct rows across 3 CMS files, allocated over 4 buckets

requirement: The system shall separate observed inputs from assumed inputs in all reporting
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard Method tab classifies every input as Observed, Derived, or Assumed
test_evidence: 6 assumptions declared with bounds and sources; 0 observed rates among them

requirement: The system shall compute recovery value net of the cost to obtain it
acceptance_criteria: Net recovery = gross recovery − appeal cost; ROI reported per category

requirement: The system shall recommend appeal only for categories where ROI exceeds 1.0
acceptance_criteria: `appeal_recommended` flag set per category; selective and blanket totals both reported

requirement: The system shall value denial prevention separately from denial recovery
acceptance_criteria: Prevention value and net recovery reported as distinct measures

requirement: The system shall disclose the share of denials reported as unclassified and flag the limit this places on root-cause management
acceptance_criteria: Unclassified share displayed prominently with the associated recommendation

requirement: The system shall perform one-at-a-time sensitivity analysis across every assumption
acceptance_criteria: `outputs/sensitivity.csv` covers all assumptions at declared low and high bounds

requirement: The system shall expose every assumption as a user-adjustable control
acceptance_criteria: Each assumption is a dashboard slider bounded by its declared range

requirement: The system shall validate modelled denial loss against a published external benchmark and fail visibly when outside it
acceptance_criteria: Calibration check compares modelled loss to the 3–5% of net patient revenue band; status is displayed and written to `outputs/calibration_check.csv`

requirement: The system shall benchmark each payer against peer medians on denial, appeal, and overturn rate
acceptance_criteria: Percentile rank computed per payer for all three measures

requirement: The system shall identify priority appeal targets as payers that both deny and overturn above median
acceptance_criteria: Composite target score computed and rendered

requirement: The system shall report denial rate by state
acceptance_criteria: State view present with issuer counts

requirement: The system shall produce a prioritized action list assigning each root cause a rank, wave, and owner
acceptance_criteria: `outputs/prioritization.csv` contains rank, wave, owner, and value for every root cause

requirement: The system shall deliver a Power BI ready dimensional model
acceptance_criteria: Star schema exported with conformed dimensions, a Type 2 payer dimension, and DAX measure definitions; referential integrity passes
test_evidence: 7 tables, referential integrity PASS, 6 SCD2 name changes tracked

requirement: The system shall allow the reader to rescale all findings to any provider claim volume
acceptance_criteria: Claim volume is a dashboard input; all outputs recompute

requirement: The system shall document data provenance including source, vintage, and known scope limitations
acceptance_criteria: Provenance section names each source file, row count, and scope caveat
test_evidence: 3 buckets scope-noted; DQ-010 logged; 5 plan years reconciled

requirement: The full pipeline shall run end to end from a single command
acceptance_criteria: `python run_pipeline.py` completes with exit code 0

requirement: The pipeline shall complete within 5 minutes excluding downloads
acceptance_criteria: Measured runtime under 300s

requirement: The pipeline shall be reproducible from raw source without manual steps
acceptance_criteria: Fresh clone plus download produces identical outputs

requirement: The dashboard shall respond to an assumption change within 3 seconds
acceptance_criteria: Observed re-render under 3s

requirement: No protected health information shall be used or stored
acceptance_criteria: All sources are public aggregate files; documented in provenance

requirement: Every published figure shall be traceable to a source file and transformation
acceptance_criteria: Each output CSV names its inputs in the generating module docstring
